subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard publish `status_changed` as a durable, supported notification contract for downstream consumers now?
rationale: This is a new externally consumable notification kind and persisted storage surface, so implementation correctness alone does not establish that the contract should become part of the bundled plugin.

options.title: Sponsor the durable event
options.body: Keep the feature, require the upgrade-safe table ensure and runtime replay proof, then document the opt-in contract.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Close or pause this feature direction until an approved downstream consumer and long-term notification API policy justify the persisted surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable event
recommendation.body: Keep the feature, require the upgrade-safe table ensure and runtime replay proof, then document the opt-in contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current transition-storage proposal and can provide the missing implementation and proof while a repository owner decides product acceptance.
